headline: Kalpataru reports five percent fall in Q2 pre-sales to ₹1,258 crore
summary: Real estate developer Kalpataru posted pre-sales of ₹1,258 crore for Q2FY27, marking a 5% decline compared to the same period last year. Quarterly collections rose marginally to reach ₹1,189 crore. For the first half of fiscal year 2027, total pre-sales came in at ₹2,587 crore, while cumulative collections grew 9% to ₹2,554 crore. Indian retail investors tracking real estate stocks should note the softer sales momentum despite steady half-yearly collections.
why_it_matters: Slower quarterly pre-sales test real estate stock momentum.
